meta.title: Prompt Lab
meta.description: Open Prompt Lab from the lower-left of a session composer to replace, clear, or insert DeepSeek Harness system-prompt sections, and to append user messages or construct assistant messages. Reusable section templates, presets, automatic backups, and blank-window drafts are included, along with per-session global-tool switches. Only sessions you explicitly enable are affected; no jailbreak text or presets are included.
